titlePattern.singleAxisType: <Termine di genere> per bambini/classe prima – da stampare gratis
titlePattern.notes: Head-noun 'schede (didattiche)' + near-mandatory 'da stampare'; honest qualifiers only (gratis, PDF, online — decks play in the browser). Grade register uses 'classe prima/seconda/terza' in titles (harvest: classe prima 100 vs prima elementare 78; classe seconda 94 vs 5); metas weave 'prima elementare' once for the parent register. Demand-true synonyms replace calques: crucipuzzle/parole intrecciate (not 'ricerca parole'), labirinti (not 'percorso illustrato'), sequenze e ritmi (not 'modelli'), concetti topologici/indicatori spaziali (not bare 'preposizioni' = grammar intent), trova l'intruso, abbina le ombre, anagrammi. Symbolic within-10/20 arithmetic keys to 'classe prima' on the type head though decks are tagged 5-7 (regradeFlag; sv åk-1 CARRIES analog, demand-map finding #3). <=51 chars ideal / 65 hard max; all titles unique across singleAxis+intersections.
